args.message:
fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). The function
was using ROUND_HALF_UP, which fails tests/test_money.py for values
like 2.665. Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: fix: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding`.

Fixes the failing nightly test `test_half_even` (e.g. `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`).
